ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 85%) contrasted against low-intensity black pixels (approx. 15%) primarily located at the margins and central base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white field across central lobes. Low-intensity black border along the entire superior trailing edge and distal tips. Distinctive black 'fir-tree' or 'pagoda' shaped pigmentation extending vertically from the inferior center base [approx. x: 0.45-0.55, y: 0.65-1.0 relative scale] into the white area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an interior angle of approximately 58 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of approx. 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged topography with high-frequency micro-variations; pixel-amplitudes range from 2-5 pixels in the center to 15-20 pixels near the distal tips, creating a highly irregular serrated boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave mathematical curve extending from the median notch toward sharply pointed, superiorly-oriented lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of 5-8 faint, low-contrast circular ring-like outlines (diameters approx. 15-30 pixels) scattered on the right lobe; concentrated dark focal spots visible on the distal left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, high-contrast curved black linear marks (length approx. 120 pixels) in the upper right quadrant; multiple smaller, unaligned linear pixel disruptions on the lower left quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Unique 'tiered' or 'stacked' black pigmentation pattern at the inferior peduncle junction, consisting of three distinct horizontal segments of decreasing width as they ascend.
other_distinctive_markers: Randomized dark 'speckle' pixels scattered throughout the central white field, with a specific dense cluster near the far-left lateral margin.
